pack_name: Goody Goods FASH.MEN Child Override Production Pack
business_goal: Production-ready male apparel branch built on shared apparel standard with small user surface, safe routing and runtime-ready gates.
definition_of_done: FASH.MEN effective spec builds as FASH.APPAREL_COMMON + child overrides
No duplicated common attributes in child pack
target_gender default MEN; allowed MEN and UNISEX only
age_group default ADULT; allowed ADULT and TEEN only
DRESS/SKIRT/BRA/BLOUSE/ROMPER are blocked/cross-route, not regular male apparel types
Primary user surface per type group stays <= 8 initial fields and <= 7 primary filters
Negative route queries do not route shoes/bags/accessories/beauty/watches into FASH.MEN
Vision does not infer MEN from color/style alone
Golden queries and sample offers validate route, type, defaults and inherited fields

runtime_readiness.requires_common_standard: FASH.APPAREL_COMMON >= 1.1 or adapter patch in common_dependency_patch file
